scripts.dev: go tool gsx dev -build 'go build -o tmp/lab ./examples/lab' -run tmp/lab
scripts.dev:datastar: LAB_APP=datastar go tool gsx dev -build 'go build -o tmp/datastar ./examples/datastar' -run tmp/datastar
scripts.dev:hybrid: LAB_APP=hybrid go tool gsx dev -build 'go build -o tmp/hybrid ./examples/hybrid' -run tmp/hybrid
scripts.e2e:serve: npm run build && go tool gsx generate ./examples/lab && GO_PORT=8899 go run ./examples/lab
scripts.e2e:serve:datastar: npm run build:datastar && go tool gsx generate ./examples/datastar && GO_PORT=8898 go run ./examples/datastar
scripts.e2e:serve:hybrid: npm run build:hybrid && go tool gsx generate ./examples/hybrid && GO_PORT=8897 go run ./examples/hybrid
